observations.result: State, contracts, architecture, distribution metadata, strict typecheck, 66 tests with 327 expectations, Electron compilation, Knip and report-only Fallow health all pass; Fallow health is 89.0/A with only the pre-existing scripts/status.ts collectRow moderate advisory and documented distribution warnings.
No issues in the 5 changed retrieval implementation, renderer, shared contract, fixture and test files for this hardening increment.
No unused files, dependencies or exports reported.

66 tests with 327 expectations pass, including scoped retrieval, persisted revision reuse, edit/delete invalidation, source revision citations, missing/conflicting evidence, prompt-injection warnings, cross-vault isolation, IPC validation and journey entry-point coverage.
Main 89.91 KB, preload 3.71 KB and renderer 74.65 KB bundles compile with persisted retrieval indexing, safety metadata, progress events and the grounded-search workspace panel.

implemented: Added a local hybrid retrieval broker that combines exact term scoring with deterministic local feature-vector similarity and supports bounded folder, path, tag and modified-date scope filters.
Applied default application-data exclusions and user exclusions before reading candidate content, and emitted progress events with indexed, excluded and scoped-out counts.
Added revision-aware source citations with exact relative path, heading, line range, snippet and source hash, plus a renderer source action that opens and focuses the cited note line.

Added an explicit local grounded-search UI and source-only answer contract that shows selected scope, provider destination none, source-grounded state, missing evidence and no-model-inference labeling.

Added an app-data retrieval index with revision reuse and edit/delete invalidation, exact-term safety anchoring for grounded evidence, deterministic conflict detection, prompt-injection warnings and an explicit selected-vault safety boundary.
limitations: This slice does not contact a provider or run model inference; the local vector score is a deterministic feature fallback, not a downloaded embedding model.
Provider-neutral model lifecycle, model-backed adjudication, richer conflicting-claim adjudication and cross-platform/reference release scoring remain pending in P4.1/P4.3.
The Electron binary is unavailable locally, so visible progress/citation automation, screen-reader inspection and cross-platform/reference grounding runs remain external-pending.
